description: This PHP source file defines the ProcessField class, a deprecated Drupal migration process plugin that retrieves a value by calling a method on a field plugin instance, based on configuration. It manages plugin instantiation and method invocation, and is part of Drupal's migration framework.

classes.name: ProcessField
classes.description: A deprecated Drupal migration process plugin class that calls a method on a field plugin instance to retrieve a value during migration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the ProcessField plugin, initializes plugin manager and migration, triggers deprecation warning.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of ProcessField, retrieving the plugin manager from the container.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms input value by calling a specified method on a field plugin instance; throws exception if input is not string or method not specified.

methods.name: callMethodOnFieldPlugin
methods.description: Instantiates a field plugin based on field type and calls a specified method on it, passing the source row.
